stem: Which statement describes one reason the year 2008 was significant?

options.label: A
options.text: First Lady Hillary Clinton testified before Congress on health care reform.

options.label: B
options.text: Barack Obama was the first African American to be elected president.

options.label: C
options.text: Ross Perot was the first third party candidate to win a presidential debate.

options.label: D
options.text: President George W. Bush announced a war on terrorism.
